decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a compliance tool with nearly 200 agency templates, it has positive customer feedback, and it fits the announced push toward compliance capabilities, so management will persist with it.
The management platform is featured on the home page and sits at the core of the firm's agency-platform direction, so the heavy public commitment and investment make dropping it very unlikely.
The configurable managed plan is close to the core hosting offer, has its own page, and builds on the existing infrastructure, and any weak early uptake can be attributed to a temporary ramp-up.
